I wrote `component.html` in the folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It is a 1280px `#component` with the top nav ("Overview" marked current), the "Overview" heading, the four stat tiles and the five-item "Recent activity" list. All the text is exactly as given. It is static HTML and CSS only.

I followed `DESIGN.md`:
- **Colors, type, spacing and radii:** only the listed values.
- **Heading:** 56px light all-caps Unbounded.
- **Cards:** white with a thin accent-line border on a pale blue page.
- **Activity rows:** their hover state is a color change only.

The folder has no font files, so Unbounded and Archivo only show if they are installed locally. Otherwise the page falls back to system sans fonts.

The nav has an icon-only logo mark with no "Harbor" text, and each tile and activity row has a decorative icon. Those aren't in the acceptance criteria. I left out the word "Harbor" to keep the content exact.
